description: Six warranty-related screenshots have been placed across ~/Desktop and ~/Pictures/Screenshots. They look visually similar (each is a rendered warranty-info page). Exactly ONE screenshot contains the text 'Warranty Claim: WTY-8X4' — that screenshot is for an LG French-door refrigerator and ALSO contains a 'Serial: REF-9X4Q-22847' field. Use Raycast's Search Screenshots feature (NOT File Search — file names will not match because Raycast Search Screenshots indexes recognized OCR text inside images, while File Search only matches filenames) to find that exact screenshot. Open it from Raycast, copy ONLY the serial number 'REF-9X4Q-22847' (not the warranty claim code, not the whole line, not the entire screenshot text), and paste it into the open Apple Notes note titled 'Equipment Inventory' immediately after the existing text 'Serial: '. The current system clipboard initially contains the string 'call mom after 6'. At the end of the task the system clipboard must again contain exactly 'call mom after 6' (restore the original clipboard value after you have pasted the serial number).
